programs.title: Bawarchi
programs.desc: Shivnath (Harindranath Chattopadhyay) is the head of the Sharma family, who are so thoroughly argumentative that they have succeeded in scaring away every single cook they've ever employed. So when plucky young chef Raghu (Rajesh Khanna) shows up, nobody expects him to last long. To their surprise, however, he proves remarkably adept at satisfying everyone's independent needs. No sooner do they think him their savior than all the jewelry suddenly disappears.

programs.title: Hameshaa
programs.desc: Childhood friends Yash and Raja fall in love with Rani but their jealousy leads to the death of both Raja and Rani. When Yash comes across her lookalike, his obsession leads him down a dark path.

programs.title: Khote Sikkay
programs.desc: An unknown horseback rider is after Jhanga, an evil and troublesome gangster who has terrorised everybody in the village, because he is responsible for his father's death.
